summary: ZW Data Action Technologies filed an amended 8-K to correct disclosures on its June 26, 2026 acquisition of an 8.0% equity stake in Margo Asia Limited. CNET Technology Limited, a wholly-owned BVI subsidiary of the registrant, is the purchaser; AFFIRM MISSION LIMITED is the seller. Consideration consists of $384,000 in cash plus 180,000 shares of ZW Data common stock valued at $1.20 per share ($216,000 total). The purchase agreement is an exhibit. The amendment corrects the aggregate cash consideration, share consideration, and per-share price. Closing is subject to customary conditions.
